run_pw3d_extract: run pw3d_extract to process 3DPW dataset pickle files and generate multi-level bounding box crop information
build_multilevel_bbox_extraction: build a pipeline to extract 8-level bounding boxes from face to whole body for 3DPW sequences
create_crop_info_pickle: create a pickle file containing multi-crop bounding box info keyed by image name and person ID
generate_npz_per_level: generate per-level npz files with image names, centers, scales, poses, shapes, genders, and keypoints
export_cropped_images: export cropped 224x224 images at specified crop levels from 3DPW dataset frames
